t: This is Battersea Dogs & Cats Home, one of the oldest and best known animal rescue centres in the UK. It looks after dogs and cats until their owners, or new ones, can be found. It began in Holloway in 1860 and moved here to Battersea in 1871. The founder was Mary Tealby, an English animal welfare campaigner, who set up the home in Holloway. So the place you're standing at carries on the work she started.
